scope: Standalone TRAIN-only Yanan diagnosis; historical upgrade protocol guard obligations implemented as explicit scoped interfaces, not a claim that the former entire pipeline was reused.

fit_guard.implementation: custom Recorder + assert_split/validated fit scopes + sealed dataset per-row numeric/ID hashes + source/scaler fingerprints and actual optimizer batch-ID traces
fit_guard.reason: This finite fixed-model round has no MCUVE search; the old scientific estimators/calibration/Encoder mathematics are reused, while supervision and fit-ID checks are new separately reviewed entry points.
fit_guard.learned_operations: StandardScaler/PCA/PLS/classifier/score-adapter/optimizer receive only current source or permitted support matrices and labels. Each model records actual allowed/used IDs; query is excluded from learned operations.

api_boundaries.dataset_producer: numeric conversion restricted to master TRAIN sample columns; entire ZIP/XML parsing is not an OS filesystem restriction
api_boundaries.orchestration: process can hold full sealed999TRAIN pack and all identity metadata; no CAL/PRED numeric arrays exported. Trusted orchestration has filesystem access to raw workbooks, so this is a reviewed API boundary, not an OS sandbox or external execution certification.
api_boundaries.neural_pretrain_gradient_entry: prepared source tensors/encoded labels/weights/fit IDs, encoder/head and fixed optimization profile only; no fullpack or query arguments
api_boundaries.neural_target_gradient_entry: donor tensors/encoded labels/weights/fit IDs/seed/adaptation and model/IO only; no fullpack or query arguments
api_boundaries.inference: query features constructed after training; eval/no_grad pointwise audits with singleton/reverse/fixed permutation/batch7/batch64, logits atol=rtol1e-5, argmax agreement and full encoder/head/BN state invariance
api_boundaries.prediction_before_scoring: neural writes ID/logit/prediction JSON without truth before pure truth-join scorer; classical appends no-truth ID/prediction record with flush/fsync before cohort/metrics truth join. Classical prediction-only receipt explicitly declares decision scores not separately exported at that interface.
api_boundaries.scoring: same process, separate pure metrics functions; no query metric selects parameters/epochs/K or causes retraining. No claim of a physically isolated scoring server.

synthetic_validation_qualification: Independent reviewer identified relative-path/jobhash incompatibilities and complete-block summary counterexamples before production; corrected candidates preserve rejected source bytes.
Synthetic held-query feature/label intervention must leave same-source/same-seed learned weights/scalers/loss/order invariant; this covers the implemented synthetic cases, not all possible datasets.
Deliberate batch-dependent/state-mutating inference and truth-scoring failures must be rejected/preserve prior predictions.
Final root release tests and independent science/resource approvals remain launch prerequisites; no production scientific job has run yet.
